description: This Java source file defines the class DefaultPersistenceStreamingActor, which is a configurable implementation of an Akka actor for persistence streaming, parameterized by entity type T extending EntityIdWithRevision. It includes methods for creating Props objects for actor instantiation and manages entity class information.

classes.name: DefaultPersistenceStreamingActor
classes.description: A final class implementing a configurable Akka actor for persistence streaming, parameterized by entity type T.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for instantiating DefaultPersistenceStreamingActor with specified entity class, mapper, and unmapper functions.

methods.name: propsForTests
methods.description: Creates Props for testing purposes, allowing injection of a custom MongoReadJournal.

methods.name: getElementClass
methods.description: Returns the Class object representing the entity type T managed by this actor.
